'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Justin Desai LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''Justin Desai'''. Senate LS; shorthand expanded from scan.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
